notes.title: The Innsmouth Case - Small Update adds setting to toggle candle flickering
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Innsmouthonians![/h3]
As we reading your feedback carefully, we recently made aware of that the general flickering of candles in the game, can have an impact on the overall gameplay-experience.
Therefore, with today's small update, we added a a setting to the main menu ingame, enabling players to toggle the flickering of candles on, or off.

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list][*][b]Checkbox to enable/disable candle flickering has been added to the main menu settings[/b][/list]

[b]Thank you for your ongoing support, passion and dedication for our game!
Please keep it up! [/b]


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231950/The_Innsmouth_Case/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/8a6115ff57adc3709db3cd379400c825a474970f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: A new Update is available for The Innsmouth Case
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to your feedback we have put in some new additions to the game and of course made some further improvements to the game!

[h1]Additions/Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] We have added a short explanation of the saving mechanics to chapter 1.
[*] A saving indicator notifies the players at the end of each chapter that their progress has been saved.
[*] The "Cthulhu fthagn" achievement is now correctly connected to the story endings instead of the achievements.
[*] In the "Gilman Night" chapter, answers are reduced if the player hasn't witnessed the city's shady activities.
[*] We have added an additional music track on top.[/list]


[url=https://discord.com/invite/assemble-entertainment][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38443858/3653d08ca8c96ceb70f1e20e0d6b0f3e9ce66fe0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Greetings from Innsmouth - A new Update is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/62bf1eba2f48a75594d7d0462a5e4a3de54a4866.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

Thanks to your feedback we could fix some problems and of course make improvements to the game!

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] Vsync can now be activated and used in the options
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuning the flowcharts to avoid logic/consistency errors 
[*] Fixed check for the "[b]Seen it all[/b]" and "[b]Chtulhu Fhtagn[/b]" achievement
[*] Changed some typo errors according to the feedback from the community
[/list]
